# The examples

Each example is one application, a module under `examples/Examples/`. Its folder holds what
the compiler writes from it. `lake exe effect4 check --group NAME` checks one, and
`lake exe effect4 emit --group NAME --target ts` prints it.

| Example | Module | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`todo`](todo/todo.gen.md) | [`Examples.Todo`](../../examples/Examples/Todo.lean) | A to-do list over a repository service, with an API that adds, lists, completes and removes |
| [`cachedTodo`](cachedTodo/cachedTodo.gen.md) | [`Examples.CachedTodo`](../../examples/Examples/CachedTodo.lean) | The to-do list with a verified cache of its list in front of the repository |
| [`boundedBuffer`](boundedBuffer/boundedBuffer.gen.md) | [`Examples.BoundedBuffer`](../../examples/Examples/BoundedBuffer.lean) | A bounded buffer: two producers and two consumers share one queue of capacity two |
| [`bankAccount`](bankAccount/bankAccount.gen.md) | [`Examples.BankAccount`](../../examples/Examples/BankAccount.lean) | Bank accounts with deposits, withdrawals and transfers that keep the total of the balances |
| [`keyValueStore`](keyValueStore/keyValueStore.gen.md) | [`Examples.KeyValueStore`](../../examples/Examples/KeyValueStore.lean) | A key-value store over a storage service, with a cache of its entries in front of the storage |
| [`rateLimiter`](rateLimiter/rateLimiter.gen.md) | [`Examples.RateLimiter`](../../examples/Examples/RateLimiter.lean) | A rate limiter: at most two quote requests in flight, and a request over the limit is refused |
| [`vendingMachine`](vendingMachine/vendingMachine.gen.md) | [`Examples.VendingMachine`](../../examples/Examples/VendingMachine.lean) | A vending machine whose host rows are its events: a coin comes in, an item goes out, change returns |
